How strong were tides caused by moon 3.5 billion years ago and how would have that looked like?

This is difficult to say for a couple of reasons. Firstly the rate at which the moons orbit is moving away from the Earth hasn't always been constant. From this a mean of about 1.7cm/y might be a good ballpark figure. You can calculate that this means the moon has moved about 60,000km further away in 3.5 billion years, or had an extra tidal force of about 27%. The moons tidal force varies itself by about 20% due to the moon having a variation of up to 42,000km in distance from Earth. Unfortunately this is where things get tricky. There's more forces at play with regards to the tides than just the moon when we consider long periods of time, plate tectonics, water salinity and local geography seem to play a role in tides. The volatile nature of Earths plate tectonics during the Archean Eon (4-2.5bya) as well as lower ice content meant that the tides were believed to be higher anyway. More tidal force from the moon probably contributed but other than to say they were probably larger and more variable than today, we don't really have enough evidence to say much more than that with any degree of accuracy.
So it wasn't like tide wave sweeping across Earth, flooding vast regions?

Water began accumulating on earth at least 4.5 billion years ago. So while there was no/very little ice, the oceans may not have reached todays size in the subsequent 1 billion years. We still are somewhat debating the origins of the oceans, so we really can't say how big they were at 3.5 billion years. If they were todays size then they would have flooded low lying areas definitely. The high CO2 in the atmosphere and volatile climate probably made for bigger storms to so you probably would have seen some big tides on continental areas that were predominantly low lying. This is speculative though and, again dependant on how much water the oceans contained at this point in Earths history.

 Jesus is praying to the Father for His disciples, and this verse tells us, who are born again, that this prayer is for us also. Jesus not only prayed for us, but He then went to heaven where He makes intercession for us with the Father (Hebrews 7:25). With Jesus interceding for us with the Father, how can we not be redeemed, and forgiven of all our failures. If you are not born again, visit our web site, click on “The Gospel” link, and find out how to be born again, and saved, so you can be in fellowship with Jesus and the Father (John 17:3).

 It is wonderful to think of being saved from hell, and to have a personal relationship with God, but it is more than that, as we are now one with Jesus and the Father. This means we have the Godhead living inside us, and we have the power to overcome anything that the devil throws at us, including power over him (James 4:7). If you are born again, and have been baptized as Jesus commanded us to be, in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Ghost (Matthew 28:19), then you have the Holy Ghost living inside you. You will not realize the power of the Holy Ghost, until you acknowledge that He is there, and ask Him to give you the spiritual gifts, so that you can fulfill the commands that Jesus gave us, to do the works that He has done (John 14:12). Thank you Father for giving us the Holy Ghost to enable us to do the miracles that Jesus did.
